notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary attribute and interaction delivery surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. Direct mappings in the C++ and Java TCK catalogs are limited to active attribute subscription relevance (Clause 5.8), ordinary attribute Update values and tags (Clause 6.10), Reflect Attribute Values callback content and producing-federate metadata (Clause 6.11.1), interaction declaration (Clauses 5.1.3 and 5.1.4), and ordinary interaction send/receive content (Clauses 6.12.4 and 6.13). Passive subscription delivery after a separate active declaration establishes relevance is exercised only as supplemental behavior because there is no immutable direct requirement candidate for that assertion. Pre-connect/pre-join exceptions, invalid-handle checks, fixture setup, and cleanup are also supplemental or setup, not additional normative claims. This remains experimental public-API evidence, not conformance evidence; no provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior are asserted.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary attribute update and interaction send services with FederateAmbassador delivery callbacks
